notes.title: Development Update
notes.content: [p]Sorry for being quiet for so long! We're not dead, and the project is not abandoned. The development of the game takes longer than anticipated, and we experienced some trouble relocating to a new office; however, we're now back on track.[/p][p]From now on, we will post regular updates to keep you informed about the development progress.[/p][p]Currently, we are still working on the core game loop, integrating various systems to ensure they work together in tandem.[/p][p]Once we've completed that, we will organize the first beta test to gather some basic gameplay feedback from you.[/p][p][/p][p]Finally, we would like to thank you for being here and for following our game - it means a lot to us and keeps us motivated to overcome any challenges we encounter.[/p][p][/p][p]Ragged Games Team[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967107/2641ba148e9de84ca88471914ccd5ed37b93b104.gif"][/img][/p]
